nrIncident.routes: Between Ramsgate and St Pancras International
nrIncident.message:
A safety inspection of the track between Ashford International and Ebbsfleet International means that some lines are blocked. As a result, trains running between these stations may be cancelled, delayed by up to 60 minutes or revised.
This is expected until 13:00.
What's happened?
A potential defective section of track has been reported between Ashford International and Ebbsfleet International. While response staff attend, the line from Ashford towards Ebbsfleet is blocked, leaving only one line for trains running in both directions to use.
Response staff are en route, and are due on site at approximately 11:30.
How does this affect my journey?
Services between Ashford International and London St Pancras International will be severely disrupted, with a much reduced service running between Ashford and Ebbsfleet.
Travel to London Charing Cross, Waterloo East or London Bridge for alternative services to Ashford, Canterbury West, Ramsgate and Dover.
Travel to London Victoria for alternative services to Ashford International and Canterbury East.
What should I do?
You can use your ticket at no extra cost on:
• London Underground between London Terminals
• Fastrack Buses between Ebbsfleet and Gravesend
Southeastern have requested buses to run between Ramsgate and Dover.
